name: Min-Max Normalized Convex Combination Hybrid Search
description: An alternative to rank-based RRF is score-based fusion: min-max scale lexical scores to [0, 1] and vector scores to [0, 1], then take alpha * lexical + (1 - alpha) * vector.
prompt:
An alternative to rank-based RRF is score-based fusion: min-max scale lexical scores to [0, 1] and vector scores to [0, 1], then take alpha * lexical + (1 - alpha) * vector.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: doc_id, title, norm_bm25, norm_vec, convex_hybrid_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Min-Max normalization and 50/50 convex combination
            WITH bounds AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    raw_bm25,
                    vector_sim,
                    MIN(raw_bm25) OVER () AS min_bm25,
                    MAX(raw_bm25) OVER () AS max_bm25,
                    MIN(vector_sim) OVER () AS min_vec,
                    MAX(vector_sim) OVER () AS max_vec
                FROM search_candidates
            ),
            normalized AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    COALESCE((raw_bm25 - min_bm25) / NULLIF(max_bm25 - min_bm25, 0), 1.0) AS norm_bm25,
                    COALESCE((vector_sim - min_vec) / NULLIF(max_vec - min_vec, 0), 1.0) AS norm_vec
                FROM bounds
            )
            SELECT 
                doc_id,
                title,
                ROUND(norm_bm25, 4) AS norm_bm25,
                ROUND(norm_vec, 4) AS norm_vec,
                ROUND(0.50 * norm_bm25 + 0.50 * norm_vec, 4) AS convex_hybrid_score
            FROM normalized
            ORDER BY convex_hybrid_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Division by zero when all scores in a small result set are identical.
